methods_quotes.q: Incidence was calculated using neuroinvasive disease cases and the U.S. Census Bureau’s 2021 midyear population estimates.
Cases reported as meningitis, encephalitis, acute flaccid paralysis, or other neurologic illnesses are classified as neuroinvasive disease; the remainder are considered nonneuroinvasive disease.
